'''Nistola''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Basilisk]] during the few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. When forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Capture of Basilisk|invaded]] the planet, Nistola surrendered after the [[Katarn Commandos]] infiltrated his heavily armed flying fortress. The New Republic's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garret]] was then able to land his forces and take the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] without firing a shot.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
